m.d: A ghost is the spirit or soul of a man.
A ghost is the soul of a dead person that shows up after death.
m.e: The house was haunted by the ghost of the little boy who used to live here.

m.d: A ghost is any faint thing that looks like a shadow.
m.e: Tom was scared of a ghost.

m.d: A ghetto is a part of a city lived by poor people, especially a slum area.
m.e: Josephine Baker was a poor child from the ghetto areas around St. Louis.

m.d: Something that is ghastly is gross and scary.
If something is ghostly, it looks or feels like a ghost or reminds people of ghosts.
m.e: A ghostly figure appeared in the old house.

m.d: If something is ghostly, it is faint, pale, or hard to see.
m.e: A ghostly light shone through the fog.

m.d: A ghoul is like a ghost.
m.e: Behind the tree, you can see a ghoul.
